items.headline: Clemson's Dabo Swinney irked by plane banner urging FSU to fire Mike Norvell
items.description: Before Florida State's 36-24 loss to Clemson, a plane carrying a banner urging the school to fire Seminoles coach Mike Norvell hovered over Doak Campbell Stadium, a move Tigers coach Dabo Swinney called "embarrassing" and "shameful."

items.headline: Tait Reynolds scores 3 touchdowns in Clemson's 36-24 win over Florida State
items.description: — Tait Reynolds threw a pair of touchdown passes, his first in more than a month, as Clemson jumped out early and held off a late rally, defeating Florida State 36-24 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Plane flies misspelled 'Fire Novell' banner at Clemson-Florida State
items.description: A plane banner flying around Doak S. Campbell Stadium Saturday called for the firing of Mike Norvell and FSU board of trustees chair Peter Collins, albeit with a typo.
